proposedStatement: Inspect existing codebase and reuse proven local implementations before introducing new helpers.

falsificationCases.impact: Vacuously true; no existing code to inspect
Reusing internal helpers across strict module boundaries could create cyclic coupling

rationale: Universal engineering hygiene rule. Reduces duplication and maintenance drag without imposing framework or styling constraints.

proposedStatement: Prefer standard library capabilities over external third-party dependencies; never import a package for a few lines of code.

falsificationCases.impact: Stdlib crypto may lag behind audited third-party primitives (e.g. libsodium)
Stdlib may be incomplete in legacy runtimes

rationale: Core dependency hygiene principle. Reduces supply-chain attack surface and build bloat.

proposedStatement: Leverage native platform features before layering custom emulation or heavy abstraction frameworks.

falsificationCases.impact: Native picker styling differs between OSes, requiring uniform brand styling

rationale: Fundamental software architecture principle. Ensures performance and accessibility out of the box.

proposedStatement: Implement the minimal verified code that works; avoid speculative scaffolding for hypothetical future needs.

falsificationCases.impact: Public API contracts require stable extension points before implementations exist

rationale: Occam engineering principle. Eliminates dead code, speculative wrappers, and configuration bloat.

proposedStatement: No unrequested abstractions: no interface with one implementation, no factory for one product.

falsificationCases.impact: Without an interface with one production implementation, unit tests cannot mock external databases or network clients cleanly without monkey patching

rationale: Fails universal globalization test because testability around external seams requires single-implementation interfaces. Restored as contextual rule CANON-CTX-001.

proposedStatement: Can it be one line?: One line.

falsificationCases.context: Complex enterprise domain logic / security audits
falsificationCases.impact: Forcing complex logic into dense one-liners severely degrades code readability, auditability, and debuggability

rationale: Extreme brevity heuristic is harmful in safety-critical, audited, or multi-developer team environments. Demoted from global status.

proposedStatement: Never use gradients or blur; maintain flat border-separated surfaces.

falsificationCases.impact: Contradicts native human interface guidelines for Liquid Glass, making UI appear jarringly foreign and flat

rationale: Aesthetic grammar rule cannot be globalized. Assigned exclusively to PROFILE-DESIGN-001.

proposedStatement: All UI-bound observable view models must be isolated on @MainActor.

falsificationCases.context: React / Web application or Python service
falsificationCases.impact: Swift concurrency annotations are invalid syntax and meaningless in non-Swift runtimes

rationale: Platform-specific language feature. Assigned to PROFILE-PLAT-002.

proposedStatement: Mandatory: read the workflow markdown file before executing any task.

falsificationCases.context: Autonomous bash script execution or one-shot command line invocation
falsificationCases.impact: Blocks execution if no workflow markdown file exists

rationale: Procedural workflow command specification. Assigned to PROFILE-WORK-001.
